findings.title: Successful sale returns keyboard focus to the category selector
findings.evidence: querySelector with a comma-separated selector returns the first matching element in document order. The .filter-buttons category controls precede .gear-layout .item-list, so after a sale the query focuses the first category button rather than the next gear row.
findings.impact: Keyboard users lose their place in the gear list and must traverse the filters again to continue.
findings.closure: Prefer the next gear-list button and use a filter button only if no list item remains; verify both cases.

findings.title: Disabled sale help does not explain that the blacksmith is still locked
findings.evidence: The UI disables sale and only mentions opening hours/distance when canVisit is false. The README says the blacksmith unlocks after the settlement grows into a village, so a fresh save can have no available blacksmith to visit.
findings.impact: Players who find equipment before village growth receive instructions for reaching a service that does not exist yet.
findings.closure: When the building is not unlocked, explain the village unlock condition or otherwise distinguish locked service from closed/distant service; do not change world unlock rules.

verification.limitation: The focused projection tests do not exercise the changed Vue components. This is a UI fragment review and does not determine the overall Phase 2 gate.
